title: The Chaotic Good Spread
desc: Cross the candlelight and cut the cards. Mira reads what the mirrors murmur and what the stars are willing to spill.

title: The Guild Calendar
desc: Stay attuned to the phases of the moon, the shifting sands of season, and the fables of the fate of foxes.

title: The Notice Board
desc: Quills scratch and whispers wander. Pin your plans, pass your notes, and find the friends your fortune favors.

title: The Guild Hall
who: The door beneath the great cap
desc: Knock thrice and name yourself. The Hall keeps a hearth, a ledger, and a place for every kind of rebel.

title: Reynard's Stump
who: A fox, a lute, a likely story
desc: Lend an ear to the lute. The fox has fables to tell, and a few of them are even true.

title: The Galleon Market
desc: Honest goods for honest galleons. Trade fair, tread kindly, and take a little of the Guild home.

title: The Raising
desc: Beam by beam and day by day, the Bull builds what the village dreams. Ask him what it is all for.

title: The City on the Hill
who: Where the Lion and the Wolf keep count
desc: Dare to look toward the red towers. Learn where your heart lands between law and chaos, kindness and coin.
